result.rationale: The diff shows Google CalendarService now calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and writes the result to `credential.key` via `prisma.credential.update`. In the new parseRefreshTokenResponse, when sharing is enabled it uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema` (only access_token + a number), which strips other fields, and explicitly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing. So with sharing enabled, the persisted Google credential loses its real refresh_token/expiry_date and gains the literal string "refresh_token", permanently
